item.title: SEVERE WEATHER IMPACTING COMMUNITY HEALTH SERVICES
item.description: Due to the impact of the severe weather around the country, some Hato Hone St John programmes and services in affected areas have been postponed or cancelled.

item.title: Ambulance workload reaches new highs
item.description: Emergency ambulance demand continued to climb in 2025, reaching the highest level on record, with Hato Hone St John responding to more than half a million incidents.

item.title: Community action crucial to cardiac arrest survival
item.description: Community action remains the key to saving lives from cardiac arrest in Aotearoa New Zealand.

item.title: Life-saving device installed following community nomination
item.description: Thanks to the partnership between Hato Hone St John and MAS, Macleans Primary School and it’s East Auckland community now have 24/7 access to a new life-saving device.

item.title: Australasia's first electric ambulance proves faster, cleaner and quieter
item.description: Australasia’s first electric emergency ambulance has delivered strong results in its first year on the road, proving to be faster, cleaner and quieter than a traditional diesel ambulance.

item.title: Hato Hone St John condemns violent attacks on Auckland ambulance staff
item.description: Hato Hone St John is deeply disappointed by a series of assaults inflicted on emergency ambulance staff and vehicles in Auckland at the weekend, including the deliberate vandalism of three ambulances, that led to a delay in responding to a potentially life-threatening emergency.

item.title: Rapid response vehicle involved in collision on SH1, north of Levin
item.description: Hato Hone St John can confirm that one of its rapid response vehicles was involved in a crash with another vehicle on SH1, Poroutawhao at 10.40am on Friday, 6 March 2026.

item.title: Give to gain: Why women's hearts matter - and how we can save them
item.description: International Women’s Day invites reflection and as I write this from Sri Lanka, the first country in the world to be led by a woman, I am reminded how far women’s leadership has come globally.

item.title: A proud legacy, a strong future for ED volunteering at Hutt Hospital
item.description: After nearly nine years of dedicated service supporting patients, whānau and hospital staff in the emergency department at Hutt Hospital, Hato Hone St John is marking the transition of its ED volunteer service to Wellington Hospitals Foundation (WHF).

item.title: A DECADE OF GIVING: NINTH EMERGENCY VEHICLE DONATED TO HATO HONE ST JOHN
item.description: Southland communities will benefit from a new ambulance thanks to the generosity of philanthropist George Chan, who has now donated nine vehicles to Hato Hone St John over the last decade.
